title: Graphic Designer
description:
We are looking for a creative and adaptable Graphic Designer with a minimum of 2\+ years of experience in graphic design and internal branding.

Key Requirements:

Minimum 2\+ years of relevant experience in graphic design.

Strong expertise in CorelDRAW, especially for internal branding and print\-related works.

Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop.

Good knowledge of AI tools and the latest AI technologies for creative design.

Ability to quickly adapt to new technologies, tools, and design trends.

Basic knowledge of video editing is an added advantage.

Creative mindset with strong attention to detail and brand consistency.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
